title: Application for Maintenance under Section 144 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS)
whenToUse: Use when wife, minor child, or infirm parents seek monthly statutory maintenance from a spouse/child who has neglected or refused to maintain them despite having sufficient means.
variantComparisonNote: Summary maintenance petition under Section 144 BNSS, 2023. Modern statutory successor to Section 125 CrPC petitions.
youWillNeed: Proof of marriage, birth certificates of children, income affidavit as per Rajnesh v. Neha guidelines, proof of respondent's income/lifestyle.
legalBasis: Section 144 Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS); Rajnesh v. Neha (2020); Aditi alias Mithi v. Jitesh Sharma (2023).
mandatoryStatutoryIngredients: Applicant is unable to maintain herself / minor children
Respondent has sufficient means and earning capacity
Respondent has neglected or refused to maintain the applicant without reasonable cause
Comprehensive disclosure affidavit of assets and liabilities filed as per Supreme Court mandate

particulars.label: Court Designation
particulars.description: Principal Judge Family Court or Judicial Magistrate

particulars.label: Applicant Name
particulars.description: Full name of wife / dependent applicant

particulars.label: Respondent Name
particulars.description: Full name of husband / earning spouse

particulars.label: Monthly Maintenance Sum (INR)
particulars.description: Amount claimed per month for subsistence

aiBlocks.title: Matrimonial History & Neglect by Respondent
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Narrate marriage solemnization, domestic abuse/desertion, eviction from matrimonial home, and respondent's deliberate refusal to maintain.

aiBlocks.title: Financial Status & Standard of Living Disparity
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Detail applicant's lack of independent income, cost of living/schooling, and respondent's lucrative occupation, business assets, and opulent lifestyle.

aiBlocks.title: Prayer for Interim & Final Maintenance
aiBlocks.draftingInstruction: Draft specific prayer for monthly maintenance of ₹{{FACT:monthly_maintenance_claimed}}/- per month, litigation expenses, and urgent ad-interim maintenance pending trial.
